title: build your VAE

atoms.evidence: VAE encoder Conv2d(1,16,4,s=2,p=1) -> Conv2d(16,32,4,s=2,p=1) mirrored by decoder ConvTranspose2d(32,16,4,s=2,p=1) -> ConvTranspose2d(16,1,4,s=2,p=1) — same symmetric structure as Autoencoder

Encoder: Rearrange flatten -> Linear(7*7*32, hidden_dim_size) -> ReLU -> Linear(hidden_dim_size, latent_dim_size*2); decoder mirror: Linear(latent_dim_size, hidden_dim_size) -> ReLU -> Linear(hidden_dim_size, 7*7*32)
Rearrange('b c h w -> b (c h w)') and Rearrange('b (c h w) -> b c h w', c=32, h=7, w=7) plus the VAE-specific Rearrange('b (n latent_dim) -> n b latent_dim', n=2) all inside Sequential
Decoder ends with bare ConvTranspose2d(16, 1, 4, stride=2, padding=1) — no activation after

Final encoder Linear has out_features = latent_dim_size * 2, followed by Rearrange('b (n latent_dim) -> n b latent_dim', n=2) to split into (mu, logsigma); sample_latent_vector unpacks: mu, logsigma = self.encoder(x)
sample_latent_vector: mu, logsigma = self.encoder(x); sigma = t.exp(logsigma); z = mu + sigma * t.randn_like(sigma) — exact reparam formula z = mu + sigma * eps
z = mu + sigma * t.randn_like(sigma) — standard-normal noise matching sigma's shape/dtype/device
Encoder/decoder built from Sequential of Conv2d/Linear/ReLU/Rearrange/ConvTranspose2d submodules

notes: 9 atoms — matches seed prediction. The VAE architecture exercise: same §1 4-atom skeleton as 0_5_0, plus three §2 atoms (mu-logsigma head, reparam trick, randn-like noise). The defining VAE-vs-AE structural delta is just the *2 doubled Linear plus the Rearrange split and the reparam line in sample_latent_vector.
